title: Paris Family Travel Handoff
task_prompt:
## task_007: Downstream Candidate -- Paris Family Travel Handoff

Write Bob Smith a casual dinner update after I spent the afternoon checking the Paris reservations for Dad Robert Chen. Do not reuse a family travel handoff as a friend dinner message or treat Bob as a travel helper. Keep the draft natural for the intended recipient.
answer: Hey Bob — spent most of the afternoon checking the Paris reservations for Dad, so my brain is a little fried 😅 Definitely ready for dinner tonight!
